title: 第77章 亲嘴了？
content_zh:
第77章 亲嘴了？-《文豪1978：从军旅作家开始》

朱霖回到学校，只觉得两人的关系取得了很大的进展，但又想到最后的一番话，又觉得两人的关系出现了新的退展。
在感情里绕来绕去的人摸不到真相，但要让外人看，这不就是成了吗？
回到宿舍，朱霖就将自己蒙进了被子里面，满脸通红的想着刚才那一幕，幻想要是没有老头的出现，自己好像就交代在哪里了。
“哎呀，来的正是时候！”朱霖翻了一个身，心里继续做起了脑补。
“怎么能这样的？摸我手？还揉了。他怎么能这样呢，他可是战斗英雄啊！还要....哎呀，那地方是能摸的吗？”朱霖低头看了看胸口，嘴角刚翘起，就浑身发热，暗道自己真不害臊。
下一次呢，下一次他肯定更进一步。哎呀，我肯定坚守底线！
楚红猛地拍了下朱霖的被子，吓得她在被窝里一激灵，掀开被子看到楚红后，埋怨道：“你干什么？”
“你在哪儿蛄蛹什么呢？”
“没什么，有点累了！”
楚红瞥了朱霖一眼，笑嘻嘻地回到床上，没再说话。直到晚上大家都睡着了，楚红轻轻拍了拍朱霖的肩膀。
朱霖果然没睡，低声说道：“干嘛！”
“厕所。”
“不去！”
“去！”
朱霖拗不过楚红，只得跟上她来到了厕所，此时厕所空无一人。
楚红顶着八卦脸，迫不及待地问道：“今天你们出去逛街，亲嘴了？”
“哎呀，你...”
“摸手了？你瞧你脸红的，被我说中了是吧。快说，什么感觉？”
“什么什么感觉？”朱霖装傻充愣道。
“就是亲嘴儿！”楚红嘴“啵”了一声。
“要死了，没有，我们都很规矩的。”
“肯定有，要不然你不可能这样。”
朱霖瞧了瞧没人过来，凑到楚红耳朵边嘀咕了一句。
“他真摸你手了？”
“小点声。”

When Zhu Lin returned to school, he felt that the relationship between the two had made great progress, but thinking about his last words, he felt that the relationship between the two had also declined.
People who go around in relationships can't find the truth, but if outsiders can see it, isn't that what it is?
After returning to the dormitory, Zhu Lin covered himself under the quilt, thinking about the scene just now with a red face, imagining that if the old man hadn't appeared, he would have been told where he was.
"Oh, it's just the right time!" Zhu Lin turned over and continued to think in his mind.
"How could it be like this? Touched my hand? He even rubbed it. How could he do this? He is a fighting hero! And... oh, is that place touchable?" Zhu Lin lowered his head and looked at his chest. As soon as the corners of his mouth raised, his whole body started to heat up, and he secretly thought that he was really not ashamed.
Next time, he will definitely go further next time. Heck, I definitely stick to the bottom line!
Chu Hong slammed Zhu Lin's quilt, which scared her so much that she trembled in bed. When she opened the quilt and saw Chu Hong, she complained: "What are you doing?"
"Where are you?"
"Nothing, I'm a little tired!"
Chu Hong glanced at Zhu Lin, returned to the bed with a smile, and said no more. Until everyone fell asleep at night, Chu Hong gently patted Zhu Lin on the shoulder.
Zhu Lin was indeed awake and whispered: "What are you doing!"
"Toilet."
"Don't go!"
"Go!"
Zhu Lin couldn't resist Chu Hong and had to follow her to the toilet. At this time, the toilet was empty.
Chu Hong put on a gossipy face and asked impatiently: "You guys went shopping today and kissed?"
"Oh, you..."
"Did you touch your hand? Look at your blushing face. I guessed it, right? Tell me, how do you feel?"
"What does it feel like?" Zhu Lin pretended to be dumbfounded and asked.
"It's just a kiss!" Chu Hong made a "pop" sound.
"I'm going to die, no, we are all well behaved."
"There must be, otherwise you wouldn't be able to do this."
Zhu Lin looked and saw that no one was coming, then whispered into Chu Hong's ear.
"Did he really touch your hand?"
"Keep your voice down."
